page.layout: Single printed page. Running head at top with page number left and title centred. Main text in one full-width block of paragraphs, with some centred lines of verse-like text in the middle, then FINIS, a rule, and a row of asterisk ornaments at the foot.

main_text.p: ribus, quorum diligentia in mediis utendis tantopere in præceden-tibus urgetur. Laudem autem perseverantiæ ascribendam Christo, probant rationes sequentes quinque.

Potest ] Ratio prima, Quia officium in illo solo residet potenter conservandi fideles, ne in hac vita concidant in curiu pietatis, vel-deneciant, Statuere ] Ratio 2. Quia in eo residet potentia, secundum officium suum sistendi omnes suos in die judicii, in conspectu Dei gloriosi inculpatos, cum omni exultatione.
Vers. 25. Id est soli sapienti DEO, Servatori nostro gloria, & magnificentia, & robur, & potestas, & nunc & in omnia secula. Amen.

Ratio tertia, Quia ille est Deus solus sapiens, ut modis viisque suis hoc negotium totum solus perficiat. Servatori ] Ratio quarta, Quia Servator est noster, merito, officio, & efficacia, ut necesse sit eum quod suscepit in se perficiendum, perficere. Gloria ] Ratio 5. Quia ut in omni opere suo gloriam suam manifestari vult: sic præcipue in hoc negotio gloriosam suam Majestatem patefieri immensam suam potentiam exeri, & supremam suam in omnes, & omnia autoritatem conspici, & agnosci, & nunc, & in æternum. Ergo & perseverabitis vos verè Fideles, & gloria tota Salutis nostræ Deo cedet: Cui ut in solidum debetur, sic in æternum pendatur: AMEN.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Ornamental rule and asterisk band below FINIS; no marginal notes. Some words in the printed text are blurred (e.g. "vel-deneciant" and "curiu") and the reading of the first line is uncertain. Verse 25 and quotation are printed in italics as shown.
